abstract_en: The invention relates to an information processing technology, and discloses a patent similarity prediction model construction method and device and a patent similarity prediction method and device. According to the patent similarity prediction method and device, a training data set is obtained, patent disclosure books and comparison files corresponding to data sets in the training data set are input into a preset neural network model, and a similarity prediction score is obtained; based on the difference between the similarity prediction score and a known similarity score corresponding to the data set, parameters in the preset neural network model are optimized until the difference between the prediction score corresponding to the data set and the known similarity score is smaller than a preset threshold value, and a patent similarity prediction model is obtained, by constructing the patent similarity prediction model, the correlation between the disclosure book and the comparison file can be automatically judged, the time of manual evaluation is saved, the accuracy of patent similarity evaluation is improved, and an effective auxiliary tool for patent similarity evaluation is provided for enterprises and individuals applying patents.

abstract_en: The invention provides a patent similarity comparison and analysis method. According to the patent similarity comparison method, a semantic dependency tree is established by utilizing a natural language processing technology, technical features in a patent document are extracted, by establishing an importance scoring model of the technical features and establishing a technical feature-patent document bigraph, the similarity between the technical characteristics and the patent document is summarized and calculated, and meanwhile, a one-to-many patent comparative analysis model is established, so that whether the target patent document has novelty or not can be quickly and effectively judged.

abstract_en: The invention provides a CPC classification-based patent similarity judgment method, which comprises the following steps of: constructing a CPC category multi-classification task on a patent data set, extracting and screening nouns through patent entity information, simplifying the content of a patent text, reducing text data needing to be processed, and representing the relationship between nodes through constructing a graph. The AGNN is used for learning and updating the two representations between the nodes to realize the dynamic updating of the features, and the result of the classifier is used as the prediction result. Based on the hierarchical structure of the claims of the patent, the dependency relationship between the claims is constructed, and structural information is fused on the basis of semantics so as to meet the requirement for judging the patent similarity. According to the method, the node features are learned in a graph mode, dynamic updating of the node features is achieved through the AGNN, the integrity of the node features is ensured, in addition, the patent representation is dynamically adjusted through the context depending on the special structure of the patent claims, and therefore semantic information is reserved.

abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent patent similarity searching method and device based on semantic retrieval. The method comprises the steps of obtaining patent text related fields of a target patent, performing word segmentation on the patent text related fields of the target patent, and performing synonym expansion on a word segmentation result of the patent text related fields of the target patent through a pre-trained synonym expansion model; according to the patent text related field word segmentation result and the synonym expansion result of the target patent, creating the Query of Elasticsearch, so that roughly recalled patent data is obtained based on Elasticsearch; calculating the cosine similarity between each patent text in the roughly recalled patent data and the target patent; according to the cosine similarity, sorting each patent text in the roughly recalled patent data, and returning a final sorting result; compared with the prior art, the retrieval efficiency of patent similarity search is higher, the recall accuracy of patent similarity search is higher, and the synonym expansion model can be continuously optimized according to incremental data.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for sorting patent retrieval similarity. The method includes processes of inputting a keyword or a plurality of keywords relevant to patients required to be looked up; enabling servers to receive the inputted keywords; analyzing the keywords; searching patents relevant to the keywords in databases; outputting the patents; enabling patent similarity arithmetic units to classify the similarity of each two patents; sorting the classified patent similarity in descending order. The method has the advantages that the retrieval keywords for retrieving the patents can be inputted at one step, so that the problem of retrieval omission can be assuredly solved; the similarity is classified, so that conditions can be provided for pertinently retrieving the patents, the patent retrieval look-up work efficiency and accuracy can be greatly improved, and an effective retrieval tool can be provided for inventors and patient staffs.

abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of information processing, and provides an appearance patent similarity determination method based on comparative learning and terminal equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-compared first appearance patent file and a to-be-compared second appearance patent file; determining classification number similarity and name similarity of the first appearance patent document and the second appearance patent document; pairing the plurality of product views in the first appearance patent file with the plurality of product views in the second appearance patent file to obtain a plurality of view pairs; determining the similarity of each view pair, and calculating the view similarity of the first appearance patent file and the second appearance patent file according to the preset adaptive weight of each view learned in advance; and the weighted sum of the classification number similarity, the name similarity and the view similarity is determined as the overall similarity of the first appearance patent file and the second appearance patent file, so that the labor cost of appearance patent similarity determination can be reduced, and the accuracy of appearance patent similarity determination is improved.

abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of patent recommendation based on a specific calculation model, and particularly relates to a patent recommendation method based on a Transform encoder and a regularization strategy. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a certain number of patent data sets according to a plurality of search texts, and classifying the patent data sets according to search statements; performing data preprocessing on the search text and the patent text in the data set; establishing a word and sentence dual-processing model based on a Transform encoder and a regularization strategy, and optimizing a model structure and an output result by using the regularization strategy based on Dropout and symmetric JS divergence; sentence granularity level processing and word granularity level processing; and performing linear weighting on the sentence granularity level result and the word granularity level result, and outputting a classification result. According to the invention, the problems of inaccurate information matching caused by inconsistent lengths of the patent text and the search text and low accuracy of traditional patent recommendation in the prior art are solved.
